baseline_models.mechanism: The opening does not merely add information: it asks the group to recognize a distinguishing fact already among them, a bearer inseparable from the carried message. That marked presence relocates the community from being the source of direction to being its receiver.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points to its referent makes knowing an act of recognizing the marked presence in the group.
Messenger and carried message make the person among them a transmission relation, not merely another local voice.
Being sent forth supplies the direction from a sender into the community and therefore the asymmetry of reception.

changed_reading.before: Know that a messenger happens to be present among you.
changed_reading.after: Recognize the marked, sent presence already within the group; proximity does not turn the receiver of a message into an extension of group preference.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The counterfactual models a governance failure: if the messenger matched the community's many claims in deliberated affairs, deliberate transmission would be captured by demand and the result would be severe damage. The bone image makes the harm more specific: pressure can re-fracture something already being set.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and deliberate pace supply the messenger-side restraint that resists hurried capture.
Agreement and mutual compliance sharpen the danger from simple obedience into matching the group's preferences.
An abundance of speech or claims supplies the volume of demands that could capture judgment.
Consultation and management of opinion locate the counterfactual inside collective decision-making.
A bone broken again after being set gives the hardship a repair-reversing, not merely inconvenient, shape.

changed_reading.before: Too much compliance would make life difficult.
changed_reading.after: Prophetic noncompliance can be protective governance: matching abundant communal demands would reverse an ongoing repair and make the group bear the fracture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The three divine causatives describe guidance as formation of attraction, appearance, and aversion inside the heart. Faith becomes settled trust that clings to the inner kernel and is made perceptibly beautiful there; rejection, boundary-breaking, and disobedience become affectively repellent before they become a list of prohibited acts.

activation_trace.role: Love as a clinging attachment supplies durable attraction rather than a passing preference.
The heart's innermost kernel places that attachment at the deepest affective center.
Settled security and trust define the state made lovable, not assent detached from felt safety.
Making beauty show turns inward faith into something affectively salient to its bearer.
The heart as inward faculty is the site in which attraction and aversion are recalibrated.
Aversion opposite satisfaction supplies the negative pole of the implanted moral sensor.

changed_reading.before: Believers choose faith and reject three wrongs.
changed_reading.after: God forms a two-pole moral sensor in the inward faculty: secure trust becomes adhesive and beautiful, while three different departures become affectively alien.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ending names the outcome of the preceding counterfactual and affective formation: rushd is not merely possession of correct propositions but the capacity to hit the right face of an affair. Desire and aversion become decision equipment that prevents harmful collective judgment.

activation_trace.role: The matter or affair supplies the practical field in which the community can be well or badly directed.
Sound judgment that finds the right face of an affair defines the named outcome as practical competence.
A straight, guided course adds sustained direction to the moment of correct judgment.
Disclosure to the knower initiates the path from recognition to sound action.

changed_reading.before: The rightly guided are people holding the right belief.
changed_reading.after: The rightly directed are affectively equipped to handle affairs soundly, including resisting their own collective preferences when those preferences would injure them.

baseline_models.mechanism: A material reading overlays the moral sequence with seed, core, sheath, emergence, and path images. It distinguishes boundary events rather than flattening the three rejected terms: concealment covers, fisq exits a peel, and disobedience exits a relation of compliance. Rushd is mature navigation, while the heart is a soft inner growth-point.

activation_trace.role: A carried seed-kernel supplies the image of an implanted potential rather than a finished label.
Soft plant pith makes the heart a protected growth-center in the material analogy.
Covering seed supplies the concealed phase whose moral valence depends on what the covering does to truth.
A date emerging from its peel gives fisq a concrete boundary-crossing image.
Leaving obedience turns the final rejected term into exit from a governing relation.
The straight course supplies the criterion that distinguishes mature emergence from misdirected exit.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief, deviance, and disobedience are a three-item synonym list.
changed_reading.after: They can coexist as distinct boundary failures in a maturation process: concealment, rupture from a containing skin, and departure from a guiding relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence turns the focus counterfactual into a protocol for resisting demand pressure: do not move ahead, do not elevate the group's sound, lower it near the messenger, let hearts be exposed and refined, and wait for his emergence. Restraint preserves the deliberate pace whose capture would re-break repair.

activation_trace.role: The re-broken bone remains the focus consequence that the contextual protocol prevents.
Advancing and getting ahead supplies the temporal form of communal preemption.
Raising the voice supplies the acoustic form of pressure that can displace transmitted direction.
Audible sound makes the contest over precedence materially perceptible.
Refinement after testing turns lowered voice into heart-formation rather than mere etiquette.
Holding the self from agitation supplies the waiting capacity opposed to demand capture.

structural_cues: 49:1-5 moves in order from not advancing, to lowering voice, to tested hearts, to calling from behind barriers, to waiting.
The focus counterfactual follows this sequence and names the harm that unrestricted pressure would produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal, acoustic, and affective restraints before the focus; I infer that they are mechanisms preventing the messenger from being made responsive to group urgency. Alternatively, they may remain etiquette rules whose adjacency only illustrates, rather than causes, the 49:7 danger.

changed_reading.before: The warning concerns generic over-obedience by a leader.
changed_reading.after: The warning diagnoses a specific capture process: getting ahead, amplifying the group's voice, and refusing delay can force transmitted judgment to track urgency rather than guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report sequence supplies an operational case for 49:7. An arriving report must be made clear before it is allowed to land on a people; otherwise unmarked ignorance and agitated temperament turn information into injury and durable regret. The messenger's presence therefore does not eliminate communal epistemic labor but makes unverified pressure more culpable.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark supplies the focus demand to recognize rather than react to an unmarked claim.
A report arriving through transmission supplies the informational input that can recruit communal action.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign supplies the verification step between receipt and action.
Hitting and landing on a target gives false action a directed impact on a people.
The non-dominant mapped image of exhausting affliction exposes the bodily cost hidden inside an apparently correct strike.
Lightness of restraint and agitated temperament make ignorance an impulsive disposition, not only missing data.
A remaining trace makes regret the durable residue of an unverified intervention.
Emergence from a peel marks the report-bearer as a boundary-breaker whose news cannot be accepted at surface value.

structural_cues: 49:6 places report, verification, striking a people, ignorance, action, and regret in a single causal sequence.
49:7 immediately relocates authority by reminding the same plural audience that the messenger is among them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a report-to-impact sequence and then the messenger counterfactual; I infer that unverified reports can become communal demands the messenger must not simply match. Alternatively, 49:6 can remain a general verification rule with 49:7 addressing a separate episode of preference.

changed_reading.before: The messenger should not follow too many communal wishes.
changed_reading.after: The community must keep reports from hardening into demands on prophetic authority; verification buffers the path from incoming speech to irreversible injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation classifies the inward attraction and aversion as surplus gift and benefaction, then binds them to divine knowledge and exact restraint. Moral taste is therefore neither self-authored merit nor arbitrary feeling; it is a fitted intervention that restrains damage and reforms judgment.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty show is the focus intervention newly classified as gift.
Benefaction and gift deny that the formed disposition is the community's achievement.
A good condition supplied as favor names the resulting inward state as bestowed well-being.
Disclosure to the knower grounds the intervention in knowledge of what is being formed.
Restraint and repulsion for reform make wisdom the braking function of the implanted aversion.
Exact fastening and craft make the paired attractions a calibrated construction rather than raw impulse.

structural_cues: 49:8 begins with the accusative pair فَضْلًا ... وَنِعْمَةً directly after the causatives of 49:7.
The continuation closes with divine knowing and wisdom, not praise of human self-formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct continuation naming gift, favor, knowledge, and wisdom; I infer that these classify the affective formation itself. Alternatively, فضل and نعمة may summarize the whole guidance event without specifying the mechanism of each feeling.

changed_reading.before: A mature community deserves credit for loving faith.
changed_reading.after: Even its capacity to find faith attractive and corruption repellent is an unearned, precisely fitted restraint that protects communal judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward polarity of love and aversion becomes a public repair circuit. Fighting parties are returned to the governing affair, estrangement is removed, balance is restored, and divine love attaches to those who enact straight measure. The community that was protected from its own demands is then made responsible for restoring its own torn bonds.

activation_trace.role: Sound handling of an affair supplies the focus competence that reconciliation now tests in public.
Removing aversion between people gives the formed inner aversion a discriminating task: reject wrongdoing without preserving estrangement.
Return and turning back provide the reversible movement by which aggression re-enters right order.
Setting a thing upright turns reconciliation from truce into structural correction.
A straight balance supplies the instrument for correcting the relation without merely reversing domination.
Divine clinging love attaches the focus's affective formation to agents of equitable repair.
A fastening bond makes brotherhood the material relation that conflict stretches and reconciliation secures.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats repair before and after coercive intervention, then adds justice, straight measure, and divine love.
49:10 redescribes the parties as brothers and repeats the repair command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner love in 49:7 and divine love for equitable actors in 49:9; I infer a recursive circuit in which gifted moral attraction becomes the capacity to perform what God loves. Alternatively, the second love may simply reward justice without describing how the first love enables it.

changed_reading.before: The heart-state in 49:7 is private spiritual preference.
changed_reading.after: It is civic equipment: rightly calibrated love and aversion must return aggression, remove estrangement, and set a damaged bond upright under an even measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social prohibitions stage the focus affective mechanism rather than merely naming rules. A post-faith label of fisq marks boundary rupture; backbiting is rendered as consumption that corrupts relations and tears kinship-flesh; the hearer is asked to simulate loving that act until aversion fires. The implanted negative pole becomes a social sense organ.

activation_trace.role: Aversion opposite satisfaction is the focus sensor explicitly reenacted in the later scene.
The date leaving its peel makes the bad post-faith name a visible boundary rupture, not a neutral label.
Clinging love is posed as a deliberately intolerable attraction so the moral sensor can reverse it.
Eating as corruption and tale-bearing among people fuses the bodily image with the social act it diagnoses.
Kinship as joined flesh makes backbiting consumption of the very fabric that binds the group.
The fastening bond specifies whose social tissue is being consumed.
Loss of life and force removes the absent person's power to answer, sharpening the asymmetry of backbiting.
The later explicit recoil demonstrates the focus aversion operating through embodied imagination.

structural_cues: 49:11's reciprocal name-calling at words 27-28 uses roots ن ب ز and ل ق ب, which remain structural only because the packet lists no branch inventories for them.
49:12 moves from hidden suspicion and spying to absent speech, imagined eating, kinship flesh, death, and explicit aversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus causative aversion and a later love-to-eating question ending in aversion; I infer that the later image demonstrates how moral disgust protects an absent person's social body. Alternatively, it may be a local rhetorical comparison that does not describe the origin of the feeling.

changed_reading.before: God makes believers dislike abstract categories of wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: God-given aversion can function as embodied social perception: it lets an unseen verbal injury register as consuming the lifeless flesh of one's own bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's marked presence and practical discernment expand into a social epistemology. Created branching both differentiates and can rejoin; groups face one another, and recognition follows marks without turning them into rank. The only honor-measure is protective conduct, so knowing rightly includes resisting identity-based self-preference.

activation_trace.role: A mark pointing to its referent supplies the focus epistemic pattern that mutual recognition broadens.
Branching and dispersal supply real plurality rather than an undifferentiated mass.
Rejoining a split shows that the same branching structure can support relation instead of hierarchy.
A group whose members face one another makes tribal difference a reciprocal orientation.
Recognition and distinction after a trace or mark make difference legible without making it morally superior.
Rivalry in claimed nobility exposes the status competition that the verse's measure displaces.
Placing oneself within protection replaces inherited rank with enacted restraint.
Divine knowing prevents the human recognition system from becoming the final judge of inward worth.

structural_cues: 49:13 moves from one created pair to peoples and tribes, then gives mutual recognition as purpose and protective conduct as the honor criterion.
The plural interiors of 49:7, فِيكُمْ and قُلُوبِكُمْ, can therefore hold differentiated people without authorizing rank by group marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created differentiation, mutual recognition, and a replacement measure of honor; I infer that the focus's sound judgment must resist the group's attraction to its own inherited standing. Alternatively, 49:13 may widen the surah's ethics without specifically revising the mechanisms of 49:7.

changed_reading.before: Recognizing the messenger is an isolated act inside a homogeneous believing group.
changed_reading.after: Right recognition is a general discipline: read marks accurately, face differentiated others reciprocally, and refuse to convert social labels into claims of inward rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast separates spoken claim, outward submission, inward entry, obedience, and work. It prevents 49:7's plural address from being read as a flat declaration that every addressee already possesses the completed heart-state. The causatives may name an active formation or the criterion by which the rashidun among the audience are recognized.

activation_trace.role: The pure inner core is the focus site whose occupancy the later claim puts in question.
Uttered speech supplies the outer claim that can outrun inward reality.
Trusting assent that settles the heart defines what the claim has not yet established.
Handing over and releasing supplies an outward submission that can be real without yet exhausting faith.
Movement into an interior makes heart-faith a process with a not-yet state.
The inward faculty is explicitly the destination, confirming that verbal and interior states are not interchangeable.
Willing yielding remains an available practice even while inward entry is incomplete.
Intentional work supplies the behavioral path on which the incomplete state can still move.

structural_cues: 49:14 explicitly opposes ءَامَنَّا, أَسْلَمْنَا, and faith not yet entering hearts before reopening obedience and work.
The root ل ي ت at 49:14 word 20 is used only as a structural no-diminution cue because the packet lists no branch inventory for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later audience whose verbal Islam precedes heart-entry; I infer that 49:7 can describe formation in progress or distinguish the rashidun rather than certify every plural addressee equally. Alternatively, 49:7 and 49:14 may address different subsets, leaving the perfect causatives fully completed for the first subset.

changed_reading.before: 49:7 certifies a completed inner faith equally in everyone addressed.
changed_reading.after: 49:7 presents a heart-state and its divine formation without erasing uneven stages: speech, submission, obedience, inward settlement, and truthful action can remain distinguishable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next criterion makes inward security observable as stability under doubt and costly movement. The self and its resources are expended along an extended path, and truth is the fit between claim and enacted promise. Practical rushd is therefore embodied persistence, not pleasant affect alone.

activation_trace.role: Settled trust is the focus state whose stability the later absence of doubt tests.
Agitated doubt supplies the destabilizing motion that settled trust withstands.
Exerting full capacity under hardship turns inward orientation into costly effort.
The life-bearing self is the stake placed behind the claim.
An extended traversable road makes guidance a sustained course rather than a momentary feeling.
Fulfilling claim through action supplies the test that joins inward faith to outward truth.

structural_cues: 49:15 orders belief, absence of doubt, striving with possessions and selves, path, and truthfulness.
Its final demonstrative construction echoes 49:7's أُولَئِكَ هُمُ, linking named identity to an enacted criterion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies settled-faith language followed by doubtlessness, expenditure, path, and truthfulness; I infer that these are behavioral diagnostics of the 49:7 heart-state. Alternatively, they may define a narrower exemplary class without explaining how affection becomes action.

changed_reading.before: Loving faith is an inward feeling sufficient to identify the rightly guided.
changed_reading.after: Its truth appears as non-agitated persistence that commits resources and the living self to a sustained course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence reverses every possible claim of epistemic and moral ownership. Humans do not inform God of their religion; divine knowing spans hidden reality and observed action. Nor can submission be used to burden the messenger with a favor-debt: gentle direction into faith is God's gratuitous gift. The opening command to know is receptive recognition under an asymmetry, not mastery.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the human knower is the limited opening act now contrasted with divine comprehensive knowing.
The repeated disclosure language reverses the attempted direction of teaching: the community receives knowledge and does not supply it to God.
Burdening a recipient by rehearsing a favor exposes submission used as leverage over the messenger.
Release without exchange supplies the opposite economy in which divine guidance cannot become human credit.
Gentle indication toward road and truth names the source-direction of the faith made lovable in 49:7.
What is veiled from eyes marks the domain inaccessible to communal self-certification.
Insight of the heart joins divine sight to the exact inward site named in the focus.
Intentional action supplies the observable surface that is seen together with, but not substituted for, hidden inward reality.

structural_cues: 49:16-18 repeats divine knowing around human claims to teach, claim credit, and declare truthfulness.
49:17 reverses the direction of favor from humans toward the messenger to God toward humans and names guidance into faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human teaching-claims, favor-claims, divine guidance, unseen knowledge, and seen action; I infer that these close the asymmetry opened by 'know that among you is God's messenger.' Alternatively, the closing rebukes a distinct group while leaving the opening knowledge command less tightly connected.

changed_reading.before: The community knows its own faith, contributes it, and can present it as value to authority.
changed_reading.after: Its knowledge is received, its inward state is not self-certifying, and even its movement into faith is a gift that cannot be converted into leverage over the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates non-dominant split mappings: focus ط و ع reaches a raised blow/sound under س ط ع, while context ه د ي reaches din or threat under ه د د. It remains anchored in يُطِيعُكُمْ and is reinforced by the explicit raised-voice sequence; downstream prose should call it a form-distant acoustic analogy, never a lexical gloss of obedience or guidance.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of a blow and its raised sound renders demanded compliance as pressure that strikes through volume.
Voice-raising supplies the contextual acoustic behavior that makes the distant focus image live.
Audible sound gives communal pressure a concrete medium.
The non-dominant loud-din image supplies the possible inversion of gentle guidance when recipients turn it into noise.

changed_reading.before: Obedience in the counterfactual is quiet administrative agreement.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory acoustic layer, collective demand can become an elevated striking sound that pressures the messenger and inverts gentle direction into din.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The re-broken-bone reading is materially strange, but it is anchored in لَعَنِتُّمْ through an exact branch and gains coherence from the later sequence of repairing estrangement, setting upright, and fastening brotherhood. Downstream prose should present it as a social-body analogy, not as the exclusive sense of hardship.

activation_trace.role: A bone broken again after setting makes the threatened hardship a reversal of fragile repair.
Removal of interpersonal estrangement supplies the later setting process that can be protected or undone.
Making a thing upright resembles aligning a damaged social structure after conflict.
The fastening bond gives the repaired social body a relation that can hold or re-fracture.

changed_reading.before: The community would suffer an unspecified burden if obeyed.
changed_reading.after: Its pressure could re-break a social body still being aligned; prophetic restraint acts like protection for a fragile setting later maintained by just reconciliation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because the material branches reverse easy moral valence: seed-covering can preserve growth, while leaving a peel can describe ripening, although the verse rejects kufr and fisq. It remains anchored in the exact focus sequence and clarifies that physical inside/outside movement alone does not determine moral direction; downstream prose should retain the paradox and qualify it as a structural analogy about timing, truth, and relation.

activation_trace.role: The seed-kernel supplies latent growth inside the affection for faith.
The red-date stage makes the heart a site of unfinished maturation rather than a static container.
A fruit sheath supplies an ambivalent covering whose physical protection cannot excuse moral concealment.
The date exiting its peel supplies an emergence whose physical ripeness cannot by itself establish moral rightness.
Sound judgment in an affair becomes the criterion that assigns direction and timing to otherwise ambiguous material movement.

changed_reading.before: Inside is good, outside is bad, and the three rejected terms describe the same movement away.
changed_reading.after: Neither covering nor emergence is morally self-interpreting; right maturation depends on whether concealment serves truth, whether exit is rightly timed, and whether relation remains sound.

strongest_changes: The messenger counterfactual became a concrete anti-capture protocol spanning precedence, voice, delay, verification, and prevention of irreversible injury.
Love, adornment, and aversion became gifted moral sensing that moves from the heart into equitable conflict repair and visceral protection of absent kin.
The later not-yet entry of faith into hearts changed 49:7 from a flat certification into a potentially staged formation or criterion with distinct speech, submission, inward settlement, and action.
The closing knowledge and favor reversals made human knowing receptive and guidance unclaimable as social credit or leverage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several simultaneous mechanisms: authority protected from demand capture, affective engineering, practical judgment, social repair, and an exploratory maturation ecology. Split-root echoes also expose an acoustic inversion in which raised communal pressure can turn gentle direction into din; this remains live without displacing the stronger readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The perfect causatives in 49:7 may describe a completed state for one subset, an active formation across uneven addressees, or a criterion by which the rashidun are identified.
The seed, sheath, peel, date, and re-broken-bone images are structurally productive but should not be promoted from branch analogy to exclusive lexical meaning.
The non-dominant س ط ع and ه د د mappings are intentionally preserved as form-distant activations; their acoustic convergence may be meaningful only at the exploratory level.
The context supports both a direct causal chain from formed affection to public action and a looser relation in which later commands merely test or exemplify the heart-state.
